claims.text: LLaMEA iteratively generates, mutates, and selects algorithms based on performance metrics and runtime evaluation feedback.
LLaMEA generates algorithms that outperform covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy (CMA-ES) on the 5-D BBOB benchmark.
LLaMEA generates algorithms that outperform differential evolution (DE) on the 5-D BBOB benchmark.
Algorithms generated by LLaMEA exhibit competitive performance on 10-D and 20-D instances of BBOB test functions without having seen them during generation.

evidence.description: LLaMEA generates multiple algorithms that outperform state-of-the-art optimization algorithms (covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy and differential evolution) on the 5-D closed box optimization benchmark (BBOB).

methodologies.name: LLaMEA
methodologies.description: An evolutionary algorithm framework leveraging GPT models to iteratively generate, mutate, and select optimization algorithms based on runtime feedback.

limitations.text: The generated algorithms were not exposed to 10-D and 20-D instances during the automated generation process.

future_work.text: Automated generation and optimization of algorithms via LLMs.
